Free tools and social media data

topics.title: Custodes Rules Overhaul & Unit Changes Deep Dive
topics.what_is_driving_it: New Custodes statlines and rule previews generating immediate competitive interest with speculation about removed units and meta implications
topics.relevance_note: Pre-order cycle happening now; players need clarity on what's changing before committing money. Multiple high-engagement videos dropping simultaneously.
topics.gap_note: Community confusion about which units are removed/changed and why. Cinematic deep-dive comparing old vs new statlines with competitive analysis would own this space.

topics.title: Space Marines 3 Release & What's Actually Coming (2026 Roadmap)
topics.what_is_driving_it: Official announcement of Space Marine 3 release date combined with broader 2026 release schedule speculation driving massive engagement
topics.relevance_note: Flagship faction release; core audience curiosity. Multiple creators covering this means high discoverability opportunity.
topics.gap_note: Fans hungry for cinematic breakdown of which chapters/subfactions will get rules, lore implications, and competitive viability. High-production narrative-gameplay hybrid content would stand out.

topics.title: Lion El'Jonson New Rules Analysis - Divergent Chapter Rules Explained
topics.what_is_driving_it: Primarch rules update generating excitement about how Divergent Chapter mechanics unlock new army-building possibilities
topics.relevance_note: Primarchs are lore-focal characters; rules reveal directly impacts list-building and narrative army appeal. Time-sensitive competitive interest.
topics.gap_note: Players want tactical breakdowns of how new Divergent rules interact with existing Space Marine codex. Showmatch or detailed rules walkthrough content would fill this.

topics.title: NOVA Open GT 2026 - Winning Lists & Meta Breakdown
topics.what_is_driving_it: Recent major tournament results providing real competitive data on what armies are winning and how the meta is evolving
topics.relevance_note: Tournament data is scarce, high-value content for competitive players. Winners' lists drive list-building discussions for weeks.
topics.gap_note: Competitive players struggle to find comprehensive top-8 breakdowns with tactical insights. Deep-dive on winning army compositions, synergies, and matchup strategies would own this.

topics.title: Kill Team 2026 New Releases & Faction Guide for Beginners
topics.what_is_driving_it: Multiple Kill Team videos surfacing simultaneously including beginner tournament content and faction overviews; strong engagement signal for skirmish game interest
topics.relevance_note: Kill Team has lower entry barrier than 40K; community asking how to start. High audience size hungry for accessible beginner content.
topics.gap_note: Few cinematic 'which Kill Team faction should YOU choose' guides exist. Comparison video vs 40K scale gameplay, faction showcase, or tournament preparation series would perform.

topics.title: Warhammer Tone Pro Painting Tool - Beginner Techniques & Showcase
topics.what_is_driving_it: Official Warhammer Community featuring Tone Pro tool with multiple preview videos; Golden Demon interview content signaling this is new hot painting equipment
topics.relevance_note: Official backing + Golden Demon coverage = high credibility. Painters looking to upgrade tools/techniques. Pre-order cycle active.
topics.gap_note: Lots of 'what is Tone Pro' but few beginner walkthroughs. Cinematic before/after painting series using the tool, or comparison to traditional methods, would attract hobby audience.

topics.title: Incubi Lore Explained - Dark Eldar Melee Elite Deep Dive
topics.what_is_driving_it: Majorkill's lore explanation format driving engagement; Incubi are underexplored faction within Dark Eldar, creating curiosity
topics.relevance_note: Lore video creators have massive engagement; niche subfaction content performs well. Community hungry for character-driven explanations.
topics.gap_note: Already covered by major creator, but opportunity to expand with cinematic battle narrative or faction origin story video.

topics.title: Games Workshop Q&A Recap - Everything Announced for 2026
topics.what_is_driving_it: Official Q&A generating clarification on roadmap, rules FAQs, and community concerns; immediate demand for synthesis
topics.relevance_note: Q&As often contain buried information; players need curated breakdown. High search volume for 'what did GW announce' posts.
topics.gap_note: Opportunity for 'top 10 biggest reveals' or 'questions GW avoided' style video breaking down implications for different factions/game systems.

topics.title: Warhammer 40K Video Game Announcements - Dawn of War 4 Gameplay Deep Dive
topics.what_is_driving_it: IGN releasing multiple Dawn of War 4 gameplay videos; crossover audience (video gamers + tabletop) creating buzz
topics.relevance_note: Video game tie-ins expand 40K audience beyond tabletop players. Gameplay reveals generate sustained discussion.
topics.gap_note: Opportunity to bridge tabletop and video game audiences with 'how accurate is DoW4 to 40K lore/gameplay' or faction spotlight series matching game factions to tabletop codices.
